name: Tuna eye
summary: The eye, steamed with thuốc bắc, is the tuna plate Du lịch Phú Yên points visitors to. In 2017 the tourism article says mắt cá ngừ đại dương hầm thuốc bắc was named in a Vietnam-records food list. A later note says Tổ chức Kỷ lục Việt Nam put it, with gà nướng Sông Cầu, in a Top 100. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Tuy Hoa. Du lịch Phú Yên’s tuna article, its eye article, its food roundup, and its 6 October 2024 cẩm nang all describe this pot.
culture: The eye article says cooks in Tuy Hòa used to throw the eye away, then cooked it because it was large. It calls the plate a snack. Few people eat it with white rice. A hearty eater manages about two portions. One portion is enough to know it.

The tuna article says that in 2017 mắt cá ngừ đại dương hầm thuốc bắc was named in a Vietnam-records food list. The 29 December 2020 gà nướng note says Tổ chức Kỷ lục Việt Nam recognized the eye, with gà nướng Sông Cầu, in a Top 100 of Vietnamese dishes.
texture: The food roundup says ocean tuna often weighs 40–50 kg, so the eye is large. It is served in a small clay pot.
taste: The eye article describes a sweet, fatty eye, the nuttiness of thuốc bắc, herbs, and the heat of lemongrass and chilli. The food roundup stews the eye with thuốc bắc, vegetables, and táo tàu.
howToEat: The eye article washes the eye and puts it in a pot with thuốc bắc, seasoning, onion, garlic, and chilli. When it is served, an alcohol burner sits under the pot.

The tuna article says the eye is steamed with spices, or with thuốc bắc. The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang sends you to Lê Duẩn and bờ kè Bạch Đằng for it. The eye article also names steaming and a soup. The pot with thuốc bắc is the one it calls famous. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Lê Duẩn and bờ kè Bạch Đằng. The night article adds the Điện Biên Phủ and Lê Duẩn corner as a tuna area. Hours are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Tuna eye in Tuy Hoa — steamed with thuoc bac
